snippet.title: Katherine and Joe Jackson were both outspoken in defending Michael Jackson’s character and legacy.
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson’s parents were both outspoken in defending their son’s character and legacy. In various interviews over the years, they firmly rejected rumors and speculation about Michael being gay or “weird.” Katherine, especially, often emphasized that Michael was misunderstood by the public and that his eccentricities were exaggerated by the media. She described him as kind, gentle, and deeply spiritual, not strange—just intensely private and sensitive. Joe also defended Michael, stating that people didn’t truly know who he was and that many stories were fabricated to sell headlines.

Both parents consistently highlighted Michael’s incredible work ethic and perfectionism. They spoke about how he would rehearse for hours on end, obsessing over every detail of a performance until it was flawless. Michael’s dedication to his craft wasn’t just about talent—it was about discipline, focus, and a relentless drive to be the best. According to them, that perfectionism defined him more than any rumor ever could.

snippet.title: How Colman Domingo Transformed into Joe Jackson for Michael 🎬
snippet.description:
Colman Domingo didn't just play Joe Jackson—he became him. And the preparation was next-level. 😱🎬

In his appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, Domingo revealed the intense work behind his role as Michael Jackson's father in the biopic Michael. The physical transformation alone required two-and-a-half hours of prosthetics and colored contact lenses for every shoot, which Fallon found incredible when shown a photo of Domingo in character .

But the real work happened long before he sat in the makeup chair. Domingo explained that he starts researching the moment he gets cast, spending 40 hours a week studying video, reading, and absorbing everything about the character. His goal was never mimicry—it was about finding the "soul of a person and advocating for that" .

Domingo's dedication paid off, as Michael became the second-highest-grossing biopic of all time. Despite the film's difficult production and script changes that made Joe Jackson a more central figure, Domingo says he's proud of the final result .

🔗 Watch the full interview here: https://youtu.be/CBt_UoyYJxIv

Why this interview is a must-watch:

😱 2.5-Hour Transformation: The incredible prosthetics and makeup process.

📚 40-Hour Research Weeks: Domingo's deep commitment to the role.

🎭 Soul vs. Mimicry: His approach to capturing Joe Jackson's "essence."

👀 Jimmy Fallon's Reaction: The host's shock at the transformation photo.

snippet.title: Colman Domingo on His Joe Jackson Transformation in Michael
snippet.description:
Colman Domingo discusses becoming Joe Jackson, Michael Jackson's father, for the Michael biopic. The Friends Keep Secrets hosts react to how different he looks in the role, and Colman recalls reading a tweet about the transformation that asked, 'Can you say Oscars?' He describes it as a post with roughly 10,000 retweets; that number is his recollection, not an independently measured statistic here.

The conversation is about the craft behind playing a recognisable real person: the face, physical transformation and team involved in creating the character. The Oscars remark is a quoted reaction, not an award win or a confirmed nomination. Colman explains the attention the look attracted while the hosts talk through why they did not immediately recognise him.

On Friends Keep Secrets, with Benny Blanco, Lil Dicky (Dave Burd) and Kristin Batalucco.

snippet.title: Colman Domingo Cast as Joe Jackson in Michael Jackson Biopic | THR News
snippet.description:
Colman Domingo is set to play Michael Jackson's father, Joe Jackson, in a biopic about the late king of pop. The Lionsgate film titled 'Michael' is in production and slated for a global release on April 18, 2025. Michael Jackson's nephew Jaafar Jackson is set to play the pop singer in the film.

snippet.title: First Look at Colman Domingo and Nia Long in ‘MICHAEL’ #michael #michaeljackson #joejackson
snippet.description:
A first look has been revealed of Colman Domingo and Nia Long portraying Joe and Katherine Jackson, the parents of Michael Jackson, in the upcoming biopic MICHAEL. The casting brings together two acclaimed actors to depict the influential and complex figures who shaped Michael Jackson’s early life and career.

The film is set to explore Michael Jackson’s rise to global fame, with attention to both his musical legacy and personal background. MICHAEL is scheduled to be released in theaters on April 24, with anticipation continuing to build as more images and promotional material are unveiled.
